name: Ink Room / type specimen
rationale: Original After Hours cinema lounge, replacing the rejected proof-sheet design at the user's request. Inspired by the Ink Room saved pin's warm type on dark ground in the verified 2026-09-27 snapshot; Pinterest was inaccessible on 2026-10-18. Charcoal working surfaces, cream type, peach details, compact single-column navigation, a restrained widescreen hero, quiet metrics, rounded film cards and a spacious logbook create a substantially different whole-deck composition. Existing licensed fonts and original CSS/SVG only; no reference artwork or logos copied.
